text:
alex: Quick update — weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/apollo8b/v1/weights.tar.gz. Checksum 9f2b7d3a. ci-bot: upload verified, manifest: s3://redwood-models/apollo8b/v1/manifest.json. maria?
Maria: grabbing them now. heads-up: tokenizer.json missing pad_token and special_tokens_map, getting warnings when tokenizing long docs.
ryan: that's because tokenizer was exported from HF with legacy config. Add "pad_token": "<pad>" and a small special_tokens_map.json. I can push a patch to the artifacts bucket.
nora: also config.yaml has max_seq_len: 4096 but model was compiled for 2048. We need to regenerate compiled kernels or set config to 2048 for smoke runs.
alex: ok, set max_seq_len to 2048 for now. We'll recompile later if needed. For perf sweeps: batch_size [1,4,8,16], seq_len [256,1024,2048].
maria: starting a smoke run on dev-dedicated-gpu (2xA100). Command: `./run_bench.sh --model apollo8b --weights s3://redwood-models/apollo8b/v1/weights.tar.gz --bs 1,4,8,16 --seq 256,1024,2048 --iters 500`
ryan: add `--warmup 100` and `--kv-cache true`. Also run one pass with `--quant q4_0` to compare quant perf.
maria: pasting current smoke logs (trimmed):
```
[bench] bs=1 seq=256 p50=8.2ms p95=12.9ms throughput=120 tok/s
[bench] bs=4 seq=1024 p50=34.6ms p95=48.3ms throughput=520 tok/s
[bench] bs=8 seq=2048 p50=92ms p95=160ms throughput=850 tok/s
```
alex: looks healthy. p95 for bs=8/2048 is high but within expectations for this family. Record these and compare against q4_0 run.
nora: CI validator flagged an attention_heads mismatch: config.yaml has heads: 16 but weights metadata reports 12. Could be a packaging mismatch — pinging model owner.
alex: @andrew PTAL on heads mismatch + tokenizer patch. If blocked, we can ship as apollo8b-v1-beta pinned to 2048 and document known tokenizer quirk.
andrew: on it — will confirm heads in weights and push tokenizer fix to s3 within ~2 hours. Will also update manifest with pad_token.
maria: thanks — will re-run the full perf sweep after your push and post final numbers here. :thumbsup:
